title: Lazar's account deserves some probability if reverse-engineering programs exist
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lazar's account deserves some probability if reverse-engineering programs exist, about 1989 at Nevada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, it's kind of intellectually disingenuous to say simultaneously I believe they're see covert reverse engineering programs and then also say the one guy with probably the most coherent story around having worked on a craft is 100% wrong.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, argues that if you believe the government runs secret programs to reverse engineer, or copy, recovered craft, you cannot also say Bob Lazar is entirely wrong. Lazar is a man who came forward in 1989 in Nevada saying he worked on such a craft, and Michels calls his the most coherent story of its kind, so in his view it deserves at least some chance of being true.
